invariants.description: Delta_Es = G_Es ln(f_esh - f_es_min + 1)(1 - exp(-t/tau_Es)) above threshold
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Delta_Es - (G_Es*np.log(f_esh - f_es_min + 1) if f_esh >= f_es_min else 0.0)*(1 - np.exp(-t/tau_Es)))) <= 1e-4*max(1.0, abs(G_Es)*5)

bc_sweep.rationale: sympathetic cardiac drive 0-30 Hz and filtered parasympathetic postganglionic activity 0-20 Hz (gee2023closed network ranges); gains/time constants 0.5-2x.

baseline.reason: Candidate: contractility (dP/dt max or Emax) change during vagus nerve stimulation from the data shipped with gee2023closed (BioModels MODEL2402270001, Rajendran 2019 pig data, .mat); needs a heart network; not set up.
